copy.curiosityHook: As the delivered footage turns increasingly intimate, the question shifts from who is filming to what long-held personal history is being dragged back into the light.
copy.description: A literary television host starts receiving clandestine videotapes of his family alongside alarming, cryptic sketches, unearthing an anonymous observer who appears tied to his long-buried past.
copy.vibeSummary: Slow, heavy, and intensely suspenseful; a demanding psychological drama built for solitary, focused viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Director Michael Haneke constructs a slow-burning French mystery where domestic comfort dissolves into quiet dread, compelling viewers to scrutinize every piece of footage.

allowedMaterial: Georges' role as a literary TV host
Receipt of anonymously filmed videotapes and cryptic drawings
Escalating intimacy of the footage pointing to someone from his past
